scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@deeplearner/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=@deeplearner/validation
scripts.watch:packages: concurrently --kill-others -n types,validation "npm run dev --workspace=@deeplearner/shared-types" "npm run dev --workspace=@deeplearner/validation"
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others -n packages,web,admin,api "npm run watch:packages" "npm run dev --workspace=@deeplearner/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@deeplearner/admin" "npm run dev --workspace=@deeplearner/api"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others -n packages,web "npm run watch:packages" "npm run dev --workspace=@deeplearner/web"
scripts.dev:admin: npm run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others -n packages,admin "npm run watch:packages" "npm run dev --workspace=@deeplearner/admin"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others -n packages,api "npm run watch:packages" "npm run dev --workspace=@deeplearner/api"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@deeplearner/web && npm run build --workspace=@deeplearner/admin && npm run build --workspace=@deeplearner/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces
